title: The generalized Mukai conjecture
main_claim: For every smooth complex Fano manifold X of dimension n>0, ρ_X(ι_X−1) ≤ n, with equality exactly for (P^{ι−1})^ρ.
coverage:
I read all six LaTeX sections in full: setup, descendants, spectral, trace and equality. No sibling reports existed on the board for family 063.

Setup: I re-derived the recurrence β_j v_β = Σ A_{j,γ} v_{β−γ} from the descendant divisor equation (its correction term vanishes because D∪pt=0) and from genus-0 topological recursion at the point marking (the two-point degree-0 side is unstable). I also checked the string-equation identity (v_β,1) = ⟨τ_{d−2}(pt)⟩_β.

Descendants: I checked several parts of the point-descendant lower bound.
- A very general point x lies only on free curves, so the open part U of the evaluation fibre is smooth of dimension h=d−2 and the virtual class restricts to [U].
- In the contraction construction, the twisted line bundle L^+ has the claimed degrees on each component of a nodal fibre.
- The weight list is right, including the count of N coordinates of weight 1.
- Boundary strata have image dimension d0+u−2 ≤ d−u−2 < h, using ι≥2. So they push forward to zero, and Φ_*[F]^vir is a nonempty effective cycle.
- The lemma 'degree ≥ b^{−(h+1)}' holds, via Gröbner degeneration to coordinate weighted projective substacks.
- The sign ψ = Φ^*ξ (rather than −ξ) agrees with known positive values: P^1 gives 1/(s!)^2, and lines in P^n give 1.
- The density of free degrees and their closure under addition and multiples are standard.

Spectral: I verified the factorial-normalized recurrence and the exponential upper bound by induction. Assuming a polynomial relation P, nilpotency gives P(A)^m=0, and the homogeneity relation reduces this to a homogeneous Q with Q(A)=0. The polynomial-differencing identity is valid because the shift operators commute. The scalar factor (p_j(k−d_δ)+δ_j)/(d_β−d_δ+k) is O(1/d). Iterating about εd times gives decay of order exp(−εd log d), which contradicts the lower bound (d+n)!/(ad)^{d−1}. Self-shifts (δ=0) cause no problem.

Trace: I checked the commutator identity [A_j,B_l]=[A_l,B_j] via the Jacobi identity, and the telescoping and pairing argument. I also tested invariance of Θ numerically with sympy, under q-dependent conjugation of commuting non-diagonal families, and it held. The diagonal computation r!·m_λ·dλ_1∧…∧dλ_r is correct. In the fixed basis, the expansion yields linearly independent γ_j with S_{γ1}…S_{γr}≠0, and the grading then gives Σ(d_γ−1) ≤ n.

Equality: Composing the correspondences gives an actual chain of curves. Degree-ι families are unsplit and are full components of RatCurves^n. The BCDD ordered-chain bound holds at every point because it rests on a pointwise deformation-theoretic dimension estimate, so it needs no covering hypothesis and using it is not circular. Cyclically rotating the chain makes every family covering, and Occhetta's theorem then gives the product.

Not checked independently: the exact hypotheses in the cited BCDD erratum, Occhetta 2006, Tian–Zong Prop 2.4, and the Mustaţă–Mustaţă construction in families. I checked these citations only for plausibility against standard versions of the results.
sibling_notes: No sibling entries existed for family 063 when I checked, and this verdict has been posted to the board.
